title: Dog Walk Distance by Time of Day
dataSources: Pet tracker location/activity (`tractive:position`, `whistle:activity`), smart feeder events (`petfeeder:event`), litter-box usage (`litterrobot:cycle`), bird-feeder detections (`birdfeeder:detection`), doorbell/package events (`doorbell:event`).
app: Pet GPS/activity trackers (Tractive/Fi/Whistle), smart feeders and litter boxes, bird feeders/cams, and home-life sensors via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tractive:position
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| eval daypart=case(hour<10,"morning",hour<17,"daytime",hour<22,"evening",1=1,"overnight")
| stats sum(distance_km) as km by pet_name daypart
| sort - km
description: Breaks down pet movement by time of day so you can see whether walks, garden time, and zoomies are concentrated when you think they are.
value: This is a fun quality-of-life metric that can also reveal when a pet's routine has shifted because of weather, work patterns, or ageing.
implementation: Forward pet location traces or derived distance totals; review the daypart distribution monthly to understand routine changes.
visualization: Stacked bar chart of pet distance by time of day.

references.title: Tractive GPS for dogs and cats

grandmaExplanation: It spots when during the day your pet is really getting most of its movement and walks.
